Synthetic test clips, generated on 25 Oct 2026 with Piper TTS (voice en_US-lessac-medium, US English) from the
text in the file name. No real person's voice. They test the speech-to-text path on clean synthetic English only;
nothing here says how AgriReach handles Ghanaian-accented English, Twi, Dagbani or Wali speech.

- en_harvest_tamale_piper.wav: "When should I harvest my soybean? I farm near Tamale."
- en_plant_wa_piper.wav: "When should I plant soybean at Wa?" (the base model hears "Wa" as "war"; kept as a known failure)
- en_harvest_tamale_piper.ogg: the same harvest clip re-encoded to OGG/Opus 48 kHz mono with PyAV (the format WhatsApp
  voice notes use).
